author: mrshoes
title: panflute scale octave and a half
description_verbatim:
to be sliced up and used in a program like SliceX to make a midi controlled instrument.  could also be sliced up and placed manually, I suppose.

I used a 3/4 in. diameter PVC tube stopped at one end and water to create all of the notes.  the notes have even temperament.  they may be slightly off in terms of tuning at the top end, but overall, I'd say not too much.

also, I used a pop filter, but halfway through I realized that for a lot of the notes I was somewhat blowing on the mic (pop filter can only do so much).  I'm sure if some were to take the time and listen for it they would, but this effect is not terribly noticeable.
